phase_name: Permission Broker Foundation Policy Applicability Implementation
summary: Production implementation of PBPA-001 v1.0 only (exactly one production file changed, confirmed via git diff --stat -- src/pcae/, and git diff --name-only -- src/pcae/commands/push.py, empty; no runtime-capability change, confirmed via pcae runtime inspect before/after: Observed / observe / unavailable, unchanged). Implemented the applicability layer in src/pcae/core/permission_broker_foundation.py: a frozen PolicyRule.applicable_execution_classes class attribute (default None = universal), one generic non-overridable PolicyRule.applies_to() predicate, registry-side applicability filtering in PolicyRegistry.evaluate_all (a non-applicable rule is never passed to its own evaluate()), construction-time registry validation (POLICY_IDS_CANONICAL completeness + duplicate-policy_id rejection, both raising ValueError, extending fail-closed from evaluate()-time to construction-time per PBPA-REQ-073/075), predicate-failure fail-closed handling (a raising or malformed applies_to() sanitizes into the same fail-closed DENY path as an evaluate() failure), and two additive PermissionBrokerDecision fields (applicable_policy_ids, non_applicable_policy_ids) with evaluated_policy_ids redefined per PBPA-REQ-081 to mean exactly the applicable set. POL-004 (MissingHumanApprovalRule) is scoped to {shell, backend, adapter, rollback} exactly as PBPA-REQ-063 froze it -- a general rule, not a push-specific carve-out; its evaluate() body is byte-for-byte unmodified. All other eleven policies remain universal (unchanged default). Updated the ~10 P-1 test call sites and replaced the P-2 test (test_broker_evaluated_policy_ids_always_all_twelve) per PBPA-REQ-081; additionally discovered and repaired a broader test-change surface the 148C.5 plan had not fully enumerated -- every ad-hoc custom-PolicyRegistry construction across the composition/rule-framework/verification-compatibility/observation-verification suites needed the canonical DEFAULT_POLICY_RULES added (construction-time validation applies to every registry, not only the default one), and the 'empty registry' tests were rewritten to assert ValueError at construction rather than DENY at evaluation. Added tests/test_permission_broker_policy_applicability.py (127 new tests: complete POL-001..012 applicability matrix, POL-004 applicable/non-applicable/evidence-independence, anti-spoofing, simulation_only non-influence, missing/duplicate-policy fail-closed, predicate-failure fail-closed, empty-set defense-in-depth, explainability determinism/partition, and all four real production consumer shapes). Confirmed via direct observation (not a B-1 closure): a conceptual PBPC push request (execution_class=mutation, approval_present=False) now resolves POL-004 as non-applicable and the decision is ALLOW -- implementation evidence only; Finding B-1 remains formally OPEN pending 148C.7's independent verification and later PBPC-001 re-evaluation. No POL-001..012 meaning changed. No POL-013+ added. No pcae push production behavior changed. No runtime capability change. See docs/PHASE_148C.6_PERMISSION_BROKER_FOUNDATION_POLICY_APPLICABILITY_IMPLEMENTATION.md for full detail, including three recorded Non-Blocking implementation findings (F-1: a plan-text imprecision in the evaluated_policy_ids formula, corrected; F-2: the broader construction-time-validation test surface, repaired; F-3: the predicate-failure fail-closed path, required and implemented beyond what the plan text anticipated).
tests_added_or_updated: Updated 5 existing test files (test_permission_broker_foundation.py, test_permission_broker_policy_composition_hardening.py, test_permission_broker_policy_rule_framework.py, test_permission_broker_verification_compatibility.py, test_permission_broker_observation_verification.py) -- P-1/P-2 call-site updates plus the broader construction-time-validation repair (Section 3 of the phase document). Added tests/test_permission_broker_policy_applicability.py (127 new tests). All existing broker suites (851 tests across 10 files, including the two unrelated Phase 88R permission_broker.py/permission_broker_cli.py files re-run unmodified) pass. Push regression (tests/test_push.py, test_commit_push_gate.py, test_staged_file_aware_push.py, test_push_phase_report_identity_137f1.py): 84 passed, 0 failed, 250.44s. Runtime regression (-k "runtime and (inspect or enforcement or registry or introspection or snapshot or context)"): 2305 passed, 0 failed. fast_green: python -m pytest -m fast_green -n auto -q: 4391 passed, 0 failed, 105 warnings, 117.90s.

no_go_confirmation: PBPA-001 v1.0 was implemented. No POL-001..012 policy meaning was changed -- every implemented rule's evaluate() body is byte-for-byte unmodified; only POL-004 gained a sibling applicability attribute. No new push permission policy (POL-013+) was introduced. No pcae push production consumption was implemented -- push.py is unchanged, confirmed via git diff --name-only -- src/pcae/commands/push.py, empty. No approval was fabricated. HUMAN_REVIEW remains non-ALLOW. Applicability remains distinct from policy decision -- the broker-level decision enum remains exactly ALLOW/DENY/HUMAN_REVIEW, no fourth value was added. NOT_APPLICABLE is not ALLOW -- it is represented only as PolicyResult.applicable=False, never synthesized as a triggered result. No caller-selectable policy exclusion was introduced -- no exclude_policies parameter or equivalent exists anywhere in the public API. Interactive Workflow Confirmation remains independent -- untouched by this diff. Authority Evaluation / AESIC remains disclosure-only -- untouched by this diff. No Runtime Enforcement behavior was changed -- confirmed by 2305 passing runtime/enforcement tests. Finding B-1 remains formally OPEN pending independent implementation verification (148C.7) and later PBPC-001 re-evaluation -- the observed ALLOW for a conceptual PBPC push request is implementation evidence only, not a closure. No runtime capability was elevated -- pcae runtime inspect remains Observed / observe / unavailable, unchanged before and after this phase. No 148D planning was begun. This phase's changes are limited to permission_broker_foundation.py (the sole production file), the six listed test files, PROJECT_STATUS.md/CHANGELOG.md/tasks bookkeeping, the new phase document, and finalization artifacts, as authorized.
